items.title: Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Rescue teams have recovered 903 bodies and saved more than 10,000 people. Around 4,200 remain unaccounted for, including about 590 foreigners from 39 countries.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
items.title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
items.summary: Water levels in the Bhotekoshi River have risen again. People in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and nearby areas should stay careful.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — public warning via official channels

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the floods hit the Bhote Koshi area, 734 bodies have been recovered and nearly 2,500 people remain unaccounted for. More than 8,000 have been rescued so far, and teams are still searching in the affected districts.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Rescue teams have recovered 626 bodies and saved over 4450 people, including 187 foreigners. About 2400 remain unaccounted for as searches continue in the affected districts.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River area on August 26, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, and hundreds of people are still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port after the slide hit Wednesday morning. As of Thursday at 8 a.m., three people had been killed and 558 were still missing.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, causing many deaths and leaving people missing. So far 359 bodies have been recovered, and 596 people from 33 countries remain unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has opened an emergency room to help with foreign nationals caught in the Rasuwa floods. Families can reach them on +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 from 7am to 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Contact numbers and emails are listed for the room, plus the Indian embassies in Kathmandu and Beijing.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal this morning, killing people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people from 25 countries are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary:
The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with local teams on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the floods around Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi.

Families can call the control room in Delhi at +91-11-23088718 or +91-11-23088719, or message the embassy on WhatsApp at +977-9851316807.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu
